title: Hajime no Ippo: Fighting Spirit!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shy high schooler Ippo Makunouchi helps his widowed mother run their fishing-boat business and is bullied by classmates. After pro boxer Mamoru Takamura rescues him from a beating and brings him to the Kamogawa Gym, Ippo discovers a talent for boxing and a longing to understand what it means to be strong. The very long series follows his professional career, his rivals and his gym mates.
life_message: It holds up relentless hard work, respect for opponents and the quest to become genuinely strong.
